en.seoTitle: Property & rental management on Costa Blanca | Nordic RentAway Spain
en.seoDescription: A local team for your home on the Costa Blanca. Rental management, property care, interior design and investment advice, from Dénia to Orihuela.
en.heading: Your home on the coast.
en.intro: Property care and rental management on the Costa Blanca. A local team, here for your home and everyone who stays in it.
en.servicesHeading:
A home in Spain.
A team on your doorstep.
en.servicesIntro: From looking after your keys to welcoming your next guests, we take care of the details. Choose the help that fits your home.
en.processIntro: Every home is different. We start by listening to what you need, then work through the practical details together.
en.processNote: The scope and fees are agreed with you before work begins.

processSteps.title: Tell us about your home
processSteps.text: Start with the location and what you would like help with. An exact address is not needed for the first conversation.

processSteps.title: Walk through the details
processSteps.text: Discuss the property, your own stays and the practical work involved.

processSteps.title: Agree the scope
processSteps.text: Clarify responsibilities, costs and arrangements before preparing the home.

processSteps.title: Prepare for what’s next
processSteps.text: Plan the agreed setup, presentation or care with the team.

en.propertiesEyebrow: A few of the homes we care for
en.propertiesIntro: By the sea, above the rooftops or in the heart of Alicante. Get to know a few properties from our rental collection.
en.teamHeading:
A familiar face.
Someone you can call.
en.teamIntro: Johan, Isabel and our international team work with owners and guests across the Alicante province. Tell us about your home, your plans and what you need from a local partner.
en.areaHeading: At home on the Costa Blanca.
en.areaIntro: From Dénia to Orihuela, this is the coast we work on. Our team’s guide, We Recommend, brings together places to eat, drink and explore.
